notes.title: HOME STRETCH
notes.content:
[TRANSMISSION INCOMING]

🌌 Galactic greetings, spacefarers! 🧑‍🚀✨

It’s been some time since our last update, and we’ve got plenty to catch you up on regarding the game’s development.

Over time, we ran into a bunch of challenges 🌠, touching not only gameplay mechanics or narrative, but reshaping our entire creative trajectory. We’ve found ourselves confronting questions we’d never asked before. For instance:

[list]
[*] 🌀 When does an abstract idea stop being intriguing and become confusing?
[*] 📖 How can we craft a story that feels seamless, captivating, and immersive?
[*] 🌟 What are the main concepts driving the story and core mechanics?
[*] 🚀 And above all, are players navigating and experiencing the game as we intended?
[/list]

Your feedback during playtests 🧪 confirmed some of our concerns, sending us right back to the drawing board. We’re making some big changes to enhance your experience. While it’s too soon to reveal all the secrets, know this: big updates are coming!

🪐 Stay tuned! The stars are calling, and Cognition Method is preparing for its next leap into the unknown.

[TRANSMISSION ENDED]

notes.title: Public Demo Update
notes.content:
[TRANSMISSION INCOMING]

Galactic greetings, astronauts! 🧑‍🚀

After a month of Alpha-playtesting, and a couple of weeks after, we are happy to inform: we’ve [b]updated[/b] our public [b]demo[/b]! As previously mentioned, we received a great amount of feedback, so we carefully read all the critics and all the praises. We are thankful to each playtester for writing down the reviews, messaging to us in Discord and filling in the form. We appreciate the time you spent with Martin Bowman at Tanmi spacecraft!

Eventually, we've fixed many bugs and slightly reworked the beginning of the game to share the progress. Here is a shorlist of updates you can find in the Public Demo:

[h3]🎹 Prologue[/h3]
Prologue sequence was polished and updated:
[list]
[*] We've added a few clues for you in case you struggle to find the puzzle solution.
[*] We've added one more puzzle to ease the learning of the new mechanics.
[*] You may see some additional events in the Prologue. If you're observant enough, you may foresee the connection with events on the Tanmi spacecraft.
[/list]
[h3]🚀 Spaceship[/h3]
The Spaceship episode has received a huge update.
[list]
[*] We've installed new terminals on board, with a sleek and stylish interface: everything to make exploring the spacecraft easier.
[*] You may also find the "holograms" across the board. These will give you a glimpse of events that happened before Martin's arrival. Remember, holograms are unlocked over the course of the game and some of them might be inactive on the Day 1.
[*] Spaceship is growing! We've added a few more rooms (not accessible yet) and marked them with colored key cards, making it easier to navigate across the vessel now.
[*] Overall, numerous props and minor details have been added to the interiors, allowing you to explore the spaceship and delve into the lore of Cognition Method.
[/list]
[h3] 🖥️ Systemic[/h3]
[list]
[*] Objective system added to the game: if you feel lost on the spaceship, just press Tab to remind yourself of Martin’s recent thoughts and next steps.
[*] The report system has been updated: reports have become shorter, so it's never boring to add a new line now!
[*] An interaction system has been added: you can now take a closer look at some books and items to find out what happened to the expedition.
[/list]

We know, you are all waiting for the release date, but everything comes at it’s time 📡

🪐For now, you are welcome to share the new updated demo with your friends! And we hope you have already added Cognition Method to your wishlist!

[TRANSMISSION ENDED]

notes.title: Halfway through the Playtest!
Playtests Announcement!
notes.content:
[TRANSMISSION INCOMING]

Ground control to the astronauts! Please set up your radio transmitters and listen: here comes the very exciting message.

We’re launching a series of playtests!

[b]Next week, we're starting the Alpha playtest on the G.Round platform[/b]
[list]
[*] You will be able to have a sneak peek into the first half of the game. It's your unique chance to feel the game's mysterious atmosphere even before the release without spoiling the finale!
[*] Remember, it's an early Alpha version. Some episodes may feel unfinished, so we want to involve you in the creation process. Don’t hesitate to share your feedback with us!
[/list]
[b]The Beta playtest is planned to take place on Steam this April[/b]
[list]
[*] The registration form is to be opened next month.
[/list]
Join us during this thrilling stage in the development of the Cognition Method, and try not to get lost in space.

[TRANSMISSION ENDED]

notes.title: Demo update: Cognition Method got a new look
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40576603/91a879746785b7d27c956840bcea303c273fdb5c.png[/img]
In the language of the Сosmos, we have traversed a significant expanse of spacetime in silence. 250 solar cycles of silence, to be precise.
It's time we break this quietude, much like a supernova piercing the tranquility of the interstellar medium.

[b]We're happy to share an updated demo build[/b], giving you a fresh perspective on the game Prologue. 

It has numerous updates on how the Cognition Method look, sounds, plays, and how it's unfolding the narrative. As for now, it gets close to what we want to release in the final game, so your feedback and reactions are as important as ever!

But there is more: If you want to see more than just s prologue - don't hesitate to find our teammates at DevGAMM Event in Vilnius. They can give you a sneak peek at the next episodes of our puzzle thriller and share some narrative details.

[i]Be safe. Stay on the line.
[/i]
